contract:
LOCAL drafts only (handoffs/ is gitignored, .gitignore:68). Never touch src/app/legal/** or src/lib/legal/terms.ts. The plan's B21 file name 'reviewer-questions.md' is really 2026-09-07-reviewer-questions.md, and the Terms draft also needs the same edits, so it is added to this batch.

1. Privacy draft
- :11: Vibe is a social app for students, clubs and orgs at IU and Purdue; the pilot is Indianapolis, one shared campus for IU Indianapolis and Purdue Indianapolis; not affiliated with, endorsed by or operated by Indiana University OR Purdue University; neither receives data.
- :24: verification accepts @iu.edu or @purdue.edu (and subdomains). @iupui.edu was retired by IU on Jan 1, 2026 and is refused with a message. @pfw.edu / @pnw.edu are not accepted yet. The onboarding steps listed must match what ships in wave 3: campus, name + handle required, optional photo/clubs/people. Flag it if wave 3 hasn't shipped at publish time.
- :25: the email proves your UNIVERSITY (school_system), not your campus. You pick a campus within your university. You can change it at most once every 30 days, and we store when you last set it. Indianapolis is one community for both universities.
- :39 table row: school email (@iu.edu / @purdue.edu) is used to set your university; add rows for the university and campus fields and the campus-change date.
- New §5 rows:
  - (a) who can see clubs you follow: the club's owner and admins, plus you; the follower count is public on the club page and hidden below 5;
  - (b) club invites: the officers of that club see who they invited and the invite's status; you get a notification;
  - (c) a club's audience setting (IU only / Purdue only) uses your university;
  - (d) editing a post replaces its text; no edit history is shown and mentions are not re-sent.
- :72: 'active now' now counts people at your campus.
- :110 'campus-wide': keep, and add that campus scoping is a relevance rule, not a privacy boundary; signed-in users can technically read other campuses' profiles, events and RSVPs (plan §2.4 honesty note, corrected by critic D2: anon reads nothing; users/orgs/events/rsvps are readable by any SIGNED-IN user).
- §6c heading :160-162: 'Indiana University and Purdue University'. Neither is sent anything; verification emails a code/link to your school address.
- :289: '[DECISION: some IU and Purdue first-year students are 17…]'.

2. Reviewer questions
- :7: pilot = Indianapolis (IU + Purdue), @iu.edu/@purdue.edu, account count as of the edit date (19 users on 2026-09-16), CONNECTVIBE. LLC.
- :12: 'IU Indianapolis and Purdue Indianapolis admit some 17-year-olds'.
- :33: 'independent of Indiana University and Purdue University'. ADD a counsel flag: the LIVE Terms name Monroe County courts (src/app/legal/terms/page.tsx:142) while the drafts say Marion County (terms draft :210, this file :33); pick one before publishing.
- :45: 'verification accepts @iu.edu and @purdue.edu (and subdomains); @iupui.edu refused as retired; one school address per account'.
- ADD a note: publishing any change to the live pages needs a TERMS_VERSION bump (currently '2026-05-07', src/lib/legal/terms.ts:1) in the same deploy, which re-prompts consent (S54).

3. Terms draft
- :36: built for IU and Purdue students; Indianapolis pilot; the email proves the university, not the campus; @iu.edu or @purdue.edu.
- :37: independent of Indiana University and Purdue University.
- :145: 'not an endorsement by IU, Purdue, or us'.
- :193: 'confirmed an IU or Purdue school email address'.
- :210: keep Marion County but add the Monroe-vs-Marion REVIEWER flag.

Add no new legal commitments beyond what the code does. Mark every assumption [REVIEWER] / [DECISION] in the drafts' existing style.
acceptance: rg -n "iupui\.edu" handoffs/legal-drafts → only in the 'retired … refused' sentences.
rg -n "Monroe" handoffs/legal-drafts/2026-09-07-reviewer-questions.md → the counsel flag is present.
git status shows no change under src/app/legal or src/lib/legal (drafts are gitignored, so nothing is committed).

Every new sentence about followers, invites, campus change and post editing matches shipped behaviour: 30 days (onboarding-prefill campusChangeDecision), follower list owner/admin (M1d header lines 44-49), floor 5 (M1d header line 84), PATCH content only (posts/[id]/route.ts:325-354).
